entry.title: Dunnottar Castle

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 equals retained standard viewer DEM12.3751m at anchor. Approximate plateauY20m and entrance10–20m compensate for the severely smoothed headland. Cliff profiles, footing and terrain joins are picture-led estimates, not bare-earth survey.

entry.note: Exact-QID site enclosure, fourteen PMTiles ruin plans, basin and western mapped steps/tunnels establish approximate fit and signed facing. Heights, damaged details, room roles and cliff levels remain estimates. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
